abstract: Smart home systems have been widespread and in high demand. However, the seemingly sky-high prices and commitment to certain brands make them accessible to a few households. To serve our client's request for a smart home system within a low-mid budget, we implemented a system using the existing WIFI network, microcontroller units, and conventional home appliances. The system is complete with smart light bulbs, door sensors, gas sensors, and temperature sensors. The users interact with the system via a web application interface deployed and hosted locally. While we have also successfully deployed the application using Heroku, we recommended that the client use the local version for security reasons. In the future, we would seek additional guidance to implement greater security measures to safeguard the client's home so we can deploy the system online. There are also many improvements and adjustments we would like to make for the future, all of which are discussed later in this report.

abstract: There are many boardgame in the real world. Some could be played in a cooperative way or competitive way. For the old styles, we could gather up and play the game on the table and have some fun. Now, technology has changed the world. We can now play board games online. So, we don't need to meet each other to play the game. Our team wants to develop one of them to play with friends too. The game that we selected to develop is 'Avalon'. We want to create this to be an online web application that anybody can play. The point of developing this project is to use WebSocket to send the right information to the right person since each role comes up with different task to do.

abstract: The Education Agency Support System is a web application aimed at addressing the challenges faced by Hearts & Minds International Education Co., Ltd. in generating cost estimations. The system provides a comprehensive solution that streamlines the agency's processes and makes it easier for staff to do their jobs. All features are cost estimation, expenses list, setup information, visa management, exchange rate management, and the ability to include a company banner on PDF files. The web application platform offers a user-friendly interface. The Education Agency Support System project is designed to help the agency generate cost estimations efficiently.
